title: CFDE Liver Resource Contact
bodyHtml: The CFDE Liver Resource strives to create an inclusive, dynamic community for liver researchers. As our resource develops, we welcome collaborations in areas including data collection and curation, tool creation, and data visualization. We value input from data providers, experts, and multidisciplinary users to ensure the utility and relevance of our resource. To collaborate, please contact us at help@cfdeliverresource.org
